verdict.rationale: Superpowers' own docs say small same-shape tasks batch into one subagent dispatch, and batch reviews check that every file in the brief reached the diff. `/execute-plan` runs batched implementation plans that subagents work through autonomously, sometimes for hours. That is genuine multi-item execution, but it is plan-task batching tuned for cost, not a general user-directed bulk-operation capability. Missing for 10: an explicit user-facing way to apply one operation across many items, documented limits or scale of batching, and independent or hands-on corroboration of batch execution.
